builtBy: By hand on 2026-11-13: the Northern California field hockey associations’ calendars, USA Field Hockey’s events pages, the tournaments’ own pages and the event and schedule pages of the 15 Northern California clubs in data/clubs.json, each read that day; spot-checked against the pages afterwards.
notes: Scope: tournaments, play days, leagues, pickup sessions and national events that Northern California club teams or players take part in, from the 2026-27 club season (with the fall 2026 events as earlier entries), plus Cal Cup, held in Ventura County, which Northern California clubs travel to. National events out of state are listed only when a Northern California club’s own page lists them, or when they are the qualifying path from the West (the National Club Championship).
A club is in an event’s `clubs` only when that club’s own page says it enters or entered it; team names on another club’s schedule do not count.

Dates are the organizer’s when it posts them. When only a club’s page gives them the event is `tentative`, and the summary says whose dates they are. An event that recurs but has no posted dates is `expected`, with no dates, and `lastHeld` gives the last edition.

Social media is never a source. Events posted only there (Fog City pickup, NorCal Sharks) are left out; the USA Gold Cup and the Bay Area Hawks Cup are cited from the Stick Together community calendar, which lists them.

Left out: Hockey Gobble (no host or date on any page), the Lions Hockey Championship (its site shows only the 2024 edition), Stryker’s events (its site stops in 2022), out-of-state club trips no national body runs (the Pumpkin Classic, the Winter Escape showcase), the National Indoor Festivals and the U-8 to U-12 National Indoor Tournament (no Northern California club lists them), and the spring 2026 tournaments whose 2027 editions are listed.
